info.title: Job Application Tracker
info.description: Track job applications and generate resumes tailored to each job description with an LLM. Every /api route needs a Supabase access token.

post.description:
Read an uploaded PDF or image into structured resume content.

Deliberately does not save: extraction can misread a layout, so the
dashboard shows the result for review and the user saves it themselves
through the normal create endpoint.

get.description:
Rule-based ATS readiness of this tailored resume, computed on request
(no LLM call, nothing stored).

schema.title: Response List Facts Api Facts Get

post.description:
Replaces the caller's whole sheet. Postgres is the source of truth;
Pinecone indexing is best effort and reported as `indexed`.

schema.title: Response List Memories Api Memories Get

AtsReport.description: A rule-based readiness check, not a prediction of any real ATS.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description:
One verified fact. Every number and tool a bullet built from it may use
must be in `numbers` / `tools` or in the text itself.

ats_keywords.title: Ats Keywords
ats_keywords.description: 8-20 short terms copied word for word from the job description
